title: In secure meetings, officials call another program and it always says 'no'

tellings.quote: then they will say: " Perfectly. Since we are in protected indoors, I will do call to this other one program that has all the knowledge and data about like this, and I'll ask them if at least something matches from what you have, from their achievements." And the answer is always " No".

plain: James Valor, of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call in UFOs, describes meetings with officials in secure government rooms in 2024 and 2025. He says that once they are in a protected room, the officials phone another programme which supposedly holds all the knowledge and data on the subject, to ask whether anything Skywatcher has matches what that programme has. According to Valor, the answer is always no.
